items.prompt: For nonnegative total s and width k, which expression rounds the exact mean to integer hundredths with half-up?

options.why: It is floor(100*s/k+1/2), with no early division of the sum.
This truncates the mean to a whole number before converting to hundredths.
This truncates at hundredths and never increments at a half-cent boundary.
This omits the scale factor 100 and therefore does not represent hundredths of the mean.
